# Stop <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Stop:Void
```

## Description

In the original this paused the program in the debugger so that you could look at its variables, and ran on when you continued.

## Differences

* Only a build made with the debug option (`-d`) stops: it is a breakpoint for a debugger, and ends the program with a signal when none is attached. In any other build `Stop` does nothing.
